_comment: Transcribed from in-game screenshots taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture index 50/51 in the 16:03 run). SELECT PRIMARY WEAPON for the text and stats, CUSTOMIZE for the art. Unlock is the Season 4 Battle Pass, per the project owner 2026-08-03: new guns ship in the Battle Pass for their launch season and only move to seasonal catch-up challenges once that season ends, so there is no challenge Requirement row while the season is current.
name: VSSM

description.text: A unique DMR with an integral suppressor and subsonic ammunition for covert operations. Aggressive configuration is available, with trade-offs.
